_comment: Default transcription config. select_by is one of name|id|all. For 'name', select is a list of case-insensitive substrings matched against audio file names. For 'id', select is a list of 11-char YouTube ids matched against the [<id>] in each audio file name (copy ids straight from data/playlists.json). For 'all', select is ignored and every audio file is transcribed. model_size/device/compute_type/task/language mirror the faster-whisper settings.
